ashamed.notes: ashamed: head down, eyes away, hands clasp

bless.notes: blesses: the right hand (the Orthodox blessing: the fingers form IC XC) draws a large cross in the air toward the others: up, down, his left, his right

bow_deep.notes: metanie: deep bow from the waist, the right hand touches the ground

carry.notes: holds a prop in the right hand, forearm forward (layer: arm R)

carry2.notes: holds a prop with both hands in front of the chest (a basket, a book)

carry_L.notes: holds a prop in the right hand, forearm forward (layer: arm R) (mirrored)

carry_side.notes: holds a light prop low at the side (a staff, a basket by its handle)

carry_side_L.notes: holds a light prop low at the side (a staff, a basket by its handle) (mirrored)

clap_once.notes: one clap in front of a long beard, without a jump

draw1.notes: draws the bow in the left hand (prop bow, bend 0 → 0.375 over 0.6–1.4 s, back over 2.4–2.9 s)

draw2.notes: draws the bow in the left hand (prop bow, bend 0 → 0.75 over 0.6–1.4 s, back over 2.4–2.9 s)

draw3.notes: draws the bow in the left hand (prop bow, bend 0 → 1.0 over 0.6–1.4 s, back over 2.4–2.9 s)

drop.notes: drops what the right hand holds (startled, the hand flies open)

drop_L.notes: drops what the right hand holds (startled, the hand flies open) (mirrored)

fold_cloth.notes: folds the two edges of a cloth over a tool lying on a low work table

give.notes: gives the prop in the right hand to someone 2.3 in front

give_L.notes: gives the prop in the right hand to someone 2.3 in front (mirrored)

hug.notes: embrace: hands on the other one's shoulders / upper arms, heads aside

idle.notes: standing humbly, hands folded in front, breathing, slow weight shift

idle2.notes: standing humbly, looks around a little, settles

joy.notes: joy: a happy bounce on the toes, hands up

knead.notes: kneads dough in a trough on a table in front of him (dough top ≈ 1.75 high, ≈ 1.0 ahead), six pushes

knead2.notes: kneads a ball of dough the whole way (presses, lifts it by the ends, pushes, rounds it); the dough deforms at runtime

knock.notes: knocks on a door in front of him with the right fist, three raps (stand ≈ 1.3 from the door)

knock_L.notes: knocks on a door in front of him with the right fist, three raps (stand ≈ 1.3 from the door) (mirrored)

laugh.notes: laughs heartily (ha-ha-ha): hands on the belly, head back, the chest shaking with each ha, a bend forward at the end

lift_up.notes: lift up: a hanging prop (basket): knees bend a little, the right hand lowers to hip height in front

lift_up_L.notes: lift up: a hanging prop (basket): knees bend a little, the right hand lowers to hip height in front (mirrored)

lunge.notes: reaches far forward after something (right hand), almost falls (arms wave), steadies himself

offer.notes: offers / invites: open right palm forward

offer_L.notes: offers / invites: open right palm forward (mirrored)

offer_sit.notes: seated: open right palm forward, from the knee and back (invites)

pick_up.notes: pick up: bends knees and waist, the right hand to the ground in front (0.78 ahead)

pick_up_L.notes: pick up: bends knees and waist, the right hand to the ground in front (0.78 ahead) (mirrored)

point.notes: points forward with the right index

point_L.notes: points forward with the right index (mirrored)

pray.notes: standing prayer: palms together before the chest, head bowed

pray_beard.notes: standing prayer: palms together before the chest, head bowed

put_down.notes: put down: bends knees and waist, the right hand to the ground in front (0.78 ahead)

put_down_L.notes: put down: bends knees and waist, the right hand to the ground in front (0.78 ahead) (mirrored)

reap.notes: reaps: bends, the left hand gathers stalks, the sickle (right hand) sweeps under them, 3 strokes right → left

reap_L.notes: reaps: bends, the left hand gathers stalks, the sickle (right hand) sweeps under them, 3 strokes right → left (mirrored)

sad.notes: sad: slumps, head down, hands together low

set_down.notes: set down: a hanging prop (basket): knees bend a little, the right hand lowers to hip height in front

set_down_L.notes: set down: a hanging prop (basket): knees bend a little, the right hand lowers to hip height in front (mirrored)

shrug.notes: asks / wonders: open palms a little forward, elbows by the body

sit_down.notes: sits down backward onto a seat 0.5 behind the feet (seat height 0.62)

sit_idle.notes: seated, hands on the knees, breathing

slip.notes: slips (a foot skids forward), arms fly out, lets go of what the right hand holds, steadies himself

stand.notes: arms hanging relaxed at the sides (the free arm of someone who carries something)

stand_up.notes: stands up from a seat (reverse of sit_down, leaning forward first)

stroll.notes: calm walk (style calm), stride 1.40 per cycle

surprised.notes: surprised: a quick half step back, hands up

take.notes: takes a prop from someone 2.3 in front into the right hand

take_L.notes: takes a prop from someone 2.3 in front into the right hand (mirrored)

talk1.notes: speaking: right hand opens forward, palm up

talk1_L.notes: speaking: right hand opens forward, palm up (mirrored)

talk2.notes: speaking: both hands open outward, palms up

talk3.notes: speaking: left hand explains, head tilts

talk4.notes: speaking about himself: right hand on the chest (beside the beard)

talk4_L.notes: speaking about himself: right hand on the chest (beside the beard) (mirrored)

think.notes: thinks: hand to the chin (strokes the beard for long beards)

think_L.notes: thinks: hand to the chin (strokes the beard for long beards) (mirrored)

think_beard.notes: thinks: hand to the chin (strokes the beard for long beards)

think_beard_L.notes: thinks: hand to the chin (strokes the beard for long beards) (mirrored)

tie.notes: ties a cord round a load in front at hip height: two knotting turns of both hands, then pulls the knot tight

turn.notes: small steps in place while the root turns (runtime blends it during heading changes)

walk.notes: walk cycle, stride 1.40 per cycle (runtime: phase = distance / stride)

wave.notes: waves the right hand (elbow low, hand in front of the shoulder)

wave_L.notes: waves the right hand (elbow low, hand in front of the shoulder) (mirrored)

weave_rim.notes: steadies a basket and follows two strips on its rim with the right index finger
